== Summary ==
Black-bordered errata card for [[Infantry Mine (Decipher Errata 1998)]], made by swccg.com on 22 November 2026 from Decipher's white-bordered Revised card [[Infantry Mine (Revised)]] (October 1998). The Revised card's game text is word for word Decipher's errata for this card (checked by eye against the Glossary entry), so its black-bordered form is the playable card with Decipher's words (Bill's ruling of 22 November 2026, swccg-guild/work #1297, spec v10).

How it was made, with [https://github.com/billbisco/ai-team-skills/blob/main/shared/swccg-wiki/evidence/pc-errata-versions/handoff-1297/tools/revised_to_black.py revised_to_black.py]: the drop shadow was cropped off along the card's black outline (367×506 → 350×490, crop box 3,3,353,493), the white border was turned black and the corners outside the rounded outline grey. Nothing else was changed: the text box, the picture and the Revised legal line are as printed.

Source scan: [[:File:Hoth-R-L-infantryminewb.gif]] (SHA-1 <code>e24bec3e5c4254387e185d37333d4d8a418cf962</code>). This file: SHA-1 <code>3d1240b3bdce75cbeaf53614429a88fedc752d09</code>.

Maker's mark: swccg.com 2026 (recorded on the page as <code>play_image_mark</code>; no mark is drawn on the image).

Fair use rationale: an image of a copyrighted Decipher card (© Decipher Inc. and Lucasfilm Ltd.), used only to show the errata'd card on this non-commercial fan wiki.
